args.title: Fix ExportButton to reset busy state on export failure
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component sets 'busy' to true on click but only resets it to false when exportReport resolves successfully. If exportReport throws due to a failed export, 'busy' stays true, leaving the Export button disabled. Add a catch block to reset 'busy' to false on failure.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component in src/components/ExportButton.tsx improperly keeps the 'busy' state true on export failure, disabling the button permanently. Adding the fix there ensures the button is re-enabled after a failed export, matching the observed problem and solution described.
